resolution.title: Upgrade paramiko in docker-sonic-mgmt to 2.9.5
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

With Debian Bookworm, Paramiko 2.9 or newer will need to be used to be able to connect to devices running that version of Debian (specifically, to those running OpenSSH 9.2).

Fixes #16851.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

Paramiko is currently on 3.3.1. For now, upgrade paramiko in docker-sonic-mgmt to 2.9.5.

#### How to verify it

Tested by running `tacacs/test_accounting.py` on a KVM image with Bookworm base image, and verifying that it all passed.

Note that there is a small risk of breakage of other tests due to the Paramiko update.
